verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS's own docs describe official Player and Broadcast SDKs for mobile and web, including broadcast SDKs for Android and iOS, so developers can build directly against first-party SDKs. The evidence is only brief marketing and overview mentions. missing for 10: SDK reference documentation depth (APIs, versions, languages), evidence of server-side/backend language SDKs for the control plane, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Integrate into interactive apps with chat APIs, and Player and Broadcast SDKs for mobile and web.
